Let me tell you what is happening out there, folks. Earlier this month, an Indiana judge, Judge Christina R., blocked a restrictive prolife law under the flimsy guise of religious freedom. 

This assault on our laws was brought forward by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, who had the audacity to argue that a commonsense Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” 

This is the direct result of progressive institutions and unaccountable courts dismantling the safeguards that protect innocent life and our cultural heritage. Instead of respecting the democratic will of the people and the sanctity of life, these leftist groups are weaponizing the courts to push their radical agenda. We are seeing activist judges undermining the rule of law and our traditional moral foundations, and we urgently need a return to traditional values, personal responsibility, and respect for the laws that keep our society from moral decay, rather than surrendering to progressive judicial activism.
